description: This source file defines data structures and a class for handling authentication API interactions such as login, token refresh, and logout in a Swift-based iOS application.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: Singleton class providing methods for user authentication including login, token refresh, and logout with mock and real API options.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login using email and password, returning a token pair, either via real network call or mock.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token, either via real network call or mock.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current session, invalidating the token on the backend if available.

methods.name: mockLogin
methods.description: Mock implementation of login returning a dummy token pair for testing purposes.

methods.name: mockRefresh
methods.description: Mock implementation of token refresh returning a dummy token pair.
